caption: Kronborg Castle, Helsingør
composition: Seaward sandstone facade and copper spires across the Øresund · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the seaward side, Kronborg's pale sandstone walls and green copper spires stand above the Øresund, with the square tower in the silhouette. A thin band of lights on the far shore is Helsingborg across the strait. The night is mainly clear, about 14.8°C, with a moderate breeze and only a little chop. The castle is moonlit, with a few warm windows, not a floodlight show; after-dark visits here are flashlight tours rather than a published facade-lighting scheme.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Kronborg Castle in Helsingør at night, moonlit above the Øresund
